title: Underwater rigid-body drag build-up: fish3d variants and printed glider, fins spread vs folded
does_not_establish: No measured or CFD-resolved drag at the target Reynolds number; no swimming, wave drag or surface taxiing; rigid deep-water build-up only.

checks.name: control: glider shell STL area >= flight_model outer wetted area (inner faces present)
control: N1 pectoral L/R area within 1%
control: v3a pectoral L/R area within 1%
control: v3b pectoral L/R area within 1%
control: v3c pectoral L/R area within 1%
control: every body length in 0.05-0.5 m (STL unit guard)
consistency only (no validation value at target Re): CFD/build-up at Re_L 1000 within 0.33-3
every drag finite and laminar <= turbulent
bound: glider CD_V (folded, transitional) in 0.005-0.2 at all speeds
recorded: printed spread pectoral root stress under water vs UTS (failing speeds are a finding)
